turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Hi there, how are you feeling today?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: I've got chicken thighs, a bag of spinach and some rice. The kids are hungry and I'm tired.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: You could do a quick garlic chicken and rice bowl, or a creamy spinach chicken in one pan. Which sounds better tonight?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Sorry, can you wait? My friend is talking to me. Keep quiet until I come back.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Ethan, can you help me figure out the food?

turns.speaker: friend
turns.text: Sure. Are we doing a meal or just snacks?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Snacks, I think. People will come and go all evening.

turns.speaker: friend
turns.text: Then a big cheese board, some dips, and maybe mini sandwiches.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: And something for the vegans. Is hummus enough?

turns.speaker: friend
turns.text: Add roasted veggies and some fruit. That's plenty.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Okay, I'm done with the dishes, your turn.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Sure thing. Still deciding between the garlic chicken bowl and the creamy one-pan version?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: The rice bowl. The kids won't eat anything creamy with green bits in it.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Fair enough. Start the rice first, it takes about twenty minutes, and fry the chicken while it cooks.
